title: Bone marrow & blood anatomy
description: The hidden factory: red marrow makes two million blood cells per second; yellow marrow stores energy; both sit behind bone you see every day.

questions.question: What is the difference between red and yellow bone marrow?
questions.answer: Red marrow supports blood-cell production. Yellow marrow contains more fat; distribution changes with age and differs across skeletal sites.

questions.question: Where are blood cells made in adults?
questions.answer: Most adult blood-cell production occurs in red marrow of axial bones and selected proximal long-bone regions.

questions.question: What is the red marrow?
questions.answer: Spongy bone of vertebrae, pelvis, sternum, epiphyses. Function: Haematopoiesis: all blood cell lines.

questions.question: Where is the trabecular (spongy) bone located?
questions.answer: Latticework of struts along stress lines. Function: Strength at low weight; houses red marrow.

questions.question: What is the function of the endosteum & osteoblasts?
questions.answer: Function: Remodelling: osteoblasts build, osteoclasts eat. Cellular lining of all internal bone surfaces.
